estimate.note: GADS canonical from cloud reference run (drafted lane, regression with village fixed effects, covariate balance check, placebo + CATE robustness): the DIRECT effect of `intensive` on `takeup_survey` is statistically indistinguishable from zero, robust across specifications and subgroups. This is a NARROWER question than the source paper answers — Cai et al. (2015) study social-network SPILLOVER effects on take-up (an IV design using `intensive`/`default` as instruments for peer take-up rates), not the simple direct effect. GADS's near-zero direct-effect finding does not contradict the paper (a naive direct effect isn't what their headline result is about) but doesn't engage with the network/spillover mechanism either. See notes.md.
